tools.name: seal_document
tools.description: Notarize a document on-chain: permanent, independently verifiable proof that a SHA-256 hash existed at this moment. Send only the hash - the document never leaves your system. Returns the PulseChain transaction, a text receipt and a PDF Certificate of Existence link. $1.00 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: pulsechain_head
tools.description: Latest PulseChain block number and timestamp. $0.001 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: pulsechain_block_by_timestamp
tools.description: Resolve a Unix timestamp (seconds) to the PulseChain block at or nearest that moment; mode 'before' or 'after'. $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: verify_seal
tools.description: FREE. Check whether a SHA-256 hash was sealed on Immuta by anyone; returns every seal with timestamp, label, note, transaction, block and PDF certificate link.
